packageRules.description: boto3 and botocore release together, and an exact pin of one needs the matching other, so update them in one PR instead of two that must be merged in order (INFRA-614).
The @letsmod/dcl-* packages are released together from the dcl-kit monorepo with one shared version, so update them in one PR per repository instead of one per package.

A new Python minor version often lands before the libraries and tools a repository depends on support it, so hold it on the Dependency Dashboard until someone approves it there. Patch updates are not affected.
